text:
𝗣𝗔𝗞𝗜𝗦𝗧𝗔𝗡 𝗪𝗜𝗡 𝗧𝗛𝗘 𝗦𝗘𝗥𝗜𝗘𝗦! 🇵🇰

Beat Sri Lanka by 8 wickets in Rawalpindi, chasing 90 after SL made 316 in their 2nd innings.
Aamer Jamal 34* off 22; series 1-0.

Best Test win this year? 👇
#PAKvSL #Cricket

👉 Rawalpindi Test mein Pakistan ne Sri Lanka ko 8 wickets se haraya
👉 SL ne doosri innings mein 316 banaye, Pakistan ko 90 ka target mila
👉 Aamer Jamal ne 22 gend mein 34* thoka; series 1-0

Kaisi lagi Pakistan ki jeet? Comment karo 👇
